title: feat(app-shell): metadata-admin reads `/meta/types` `allowEnvironmentOverlay`; the read-only banners name `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` (objectui#12141)
body:
Fixes #12141

Clause-②: yes

## Landing order

This pull request merges first. objectstack-ai/objectstack#22340 S2 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22874, held as a draft for the pin round) then bumps `.objectui-sha` to this merge. That is ruling Q1 A / Q2 A (`6073921182`): one landing for the server rename, this companion and the pin, and the order the S2 seat review restates (`6112246741`).

- Between the two merges, objectui `main` reads a field the server does not write yet. The bundled console is unaffected, because its pin stays where it is until S2.
- There is no dual read of the two names, and no fallback to the old one anywhere in this diff.
- Cloud: triage `6109764647` records the pin-pair rule on objectstack-ai/cloud#2709. Cloud's `.objectui-sha` may pass this merge only in the same commit that moves its framework pin to a commit carrying S2.

## What changes

**The rename.** `RichMetadataTypeEntry.allowOrgOverride` is now `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, and so is the member `resolveResourceConfig` takes and returns. Both are exported from the package entry, so the published type surface moves; hence `Clause-②: yes` and a `minor` changeset with the breaking semantics stated (this repo's release model, no `major`). Every reader now reads the new name:

- the editor's write gates: `canWriteByType` and the designer auto-on effect in `ResourceEditPage`;
- the permission matrix's type and artifact tiers in `PermissionMatrixEditor` (only its overlay-flag reads and the comments beside them; the cross-lane declaration is on objectstack-ai/objectstack#15194, `6115259878`);
- the type list's create gate (`ResourceListPage`), the embedded item editor's read-only gate, the directory's writable count, its "Writable only" filter and its tile badge (`DirectoryPage`), and the page header badge (`PageShell`'s `WritabilityBadge`);
- prose in `BuilderLanding`, `PicklistPreview`, `useMetadata` and `registry`, and `content/docs/guide/console.md`.

The renamed member carries a doc comment that names the wire field, its meaning under ADR-0131 D6, and that no other name is read.

**The carried banner remedy** (triage `6109764647`). `engine.edit.readOnlyTypeBanner` told an admin to set `OBJECTSTACK_METADATA_WRITABLE` and to "flip {override} in the registry". The server reads only `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE`: objectstack `main` reads it in `envWritableMetadataTypes`, with an empty legacy list. The registry is a TypeScript literal in `@objectstack/spec` that no deployment edits.

- The banner now draws `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` as its code token. It says what the hatch opens: the type's items that no package ships, never an item a package ships.
- The `{override}` placeholder and the registry flip are gone, in English and Chinese.
- The badge and label tooltips for a hatch-elevated type (`DirectoryPage`'s tile and `PageShell`'s header badge) name `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` with the same reach. They no longer name the legacy env var.
- Why the reach is stated: objectstack `main` applies the hatch to the runtime-only intent only (ADR-0131 D6). Its own refusal sentence names the hatch to say it does not open a managed item. A banner that offered the hatch unqualified on a packaged item would send the operator to a door the server keeps shut.

**Same defect class, fixed in place: the permission matrix hints.** This diff edits the two `perm.readOnly*` hints anyway, to rename the key inside them.

- `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` is shown only for a set a code package ships. It offered "ask an operator for the documented OS_METADATA_WRITABLE escape hatch" as a route, and that route does not open such a set (above). It now says the hatch does not open a set a package ships. Cloning, redeploying the source and a new runtime set are unchanged.
- `perm.readOnly.hint` (a type with no runtime write channel) keeps the hatch as a remedy and states its reach.
- The two tests that pinned the hatch as a route now pin the new sentence instead (`PermissionMatrixEditor.artifactTier` and `PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize`). The second also asserts that the old route wording is absent.
- The bounded in-place conditions all hold: the defect class is this card's; the shape is pinned by the server's own sentence; both files are in the claim's surface; and no new verification surface is added.

**Not changed, as this seat ruled:** the artifact-tier gate's logic. It still reads the flag alone; see the finding below.

## Premise checks (measured on `d2500d8`)

- H1: the readers were 11 non-test files (10 under `views/metadata-admin/` plus `studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`), 49 hits. The field was also named in 59 test files (114 hits). `StudioHomePage.tsx` is gone. The rename touched exactly 71 files: those, plus the docs page.
- H2: the export was confirmed on the built closure. `dist/index.d.ts` re-exports `RichMetadataTypeEntry` and `resolveResourceConfig`. After the build, `useMetadata.d.ts` and `registry.d.ts` carry `allowEnvironmentOverlay` and no `allowOrgOverride`.
- H3: confirmed. The strings live in the designer table (`views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, en and zh) and in the two tooltips. `packages/i18n` has none of them.
- H4: confirmed. Nothing reads the old name.

## Verification (final head `2c38817`)

- Dependency closure: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`, 28 of 28 tasks successful. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build` passed, with dist completeness 1062 files verified.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (it echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the second project includes every `src/**/*.test.tsx`): exit 0.
- Targeted vitest over every test file this diff touches or adds, 61 files: 20 files with 120 tests passed, and 41 files with 212 tests passed. The two new files and four of the edited ones were re-run on `2c38817`: 6 files, 70 tests passed.
- New pins:
  - `ResourceEditPage.environmentOverlay-12141`: for each of `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `translation` and `email_template`, a packaged item is editable when served the field (both flags true, as S2's registry declares them), and the same item without the field stays locked. Negative control: `api`, without overlay or runtime create, stays read-only. Its banner names `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` and no registry flip, in en and zh.
  - `DirectoryPage.environmentOverlay-12141`: the tiles and the header badge for the five types; a hatch-elevated `agent`, whose only open door is the overlay flag, is badged writable and counted; `api` and the field-less `agent` are read-only and not counted.
- Ablation: four mutations through `ablation-replace` (literal anchors, the landing checked on disk, a trap that restores, and a restore proven by HEAD blob hash with `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - the artifact arm of `canWriteByType` reading the old name: 5 failed of 12, the five positive cases;
  - `WritabilityBadge` reading the old name: 6 failed of 10;
  - the directory's writable count reading the old name: 1 failed of 10;
  - the banner token printing the legacy env var: 2 failed of 12, en and zh.
  All four turned red in the expected direction, and each restore was blob-equal.
- Gates, all exit 0 at `2c38817`: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:phantom-deps`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (3 designer en values changed, 3 zh followed), `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `docs:check-links`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:test-path-roots`, and `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape`.
- Lint, narrowed to the 72 changed TypeScript files and run as the package's own `eslint .` runs (no type-aware linting is configured, and no custom rule reads another file, so the verdict on an untouched file cannot move): 72 files, 0 errors, 176 warnings. All of the warnings were already there, and the two new test files have none.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure`, because it needs the full console build, which CI's performance-budget job owns. The diff adds 328 net bytes, uncompressed, of shipped strings to the designer table (en and zh together).

## Acceptance notes (observed; not filed)

- **The hatch value is wider than what it opens** (out of scope by this seat's ruling).
  - A probe render, not committed, used an `agent` entry the hatch elevates (`allowEnvironmentOverlay: true`, `overrideSource: 'env'`, no runtime create) and a packaged item. The editor offers Edit.
  - objectstack `main` refuses that save: the hatch admits the runtime-only intent only, and ADR-0131 D6 seals managed content. That is read from the server source, not measured live.
  - The S2 describe of the field says the elevation never opens a managed item.
  - Whether the artifact tier should also read `overrideSource` is this lane's call. It is reported to the seat.
- The landing UI copy (`engine.studio.landing.*`) and some comments still say "org overlay" after ADR-0131 D6 retired the per-org axis. That is wording only.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s type-gate comment carries three stale cross-file line addresses. They were left alone because this diff touches only that file's overlay-flag reads, as the cross-lane declaration states.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize`'s refused-save fixture quotes a pre-D6 server sentence (an escape-hatch remedy the server no longer prints). It is a fixture of the client showing the server's words, so it was left as is.
